Păles , is, f. (m., Varr. ap. Serv. ad Verg. G. 3, 1; Mart. Cap. 1, § 50; Arn. 3, 113),
I.the tutelary deity of shepherds and cattle: Pales dicebatur dea pastorum, cujus festa Palilia dicebantur; “vel, ut alii volunt, dicta Parilia, quod pro partu pecoris eidem sacra fiebant,” Fest. p. 222 Müll.: “ipsa Pales agros ... reliquit,” Verg. E. 5, 35 : “silvicolam tepido lacte precare Palem,” Ov. F. 4, 746 ; Tib. 1, 1, 14 (36): “fecunda,” Calp. Ecl. 7, 22 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
